header: One row that scrolls sideways instead of wrapping
lead: Scroll snapping and overflow, and nothing else. The band stays one screen tall however many cards there are, which is what makes it the answer to a long capability set on a short page.

items.title: Snap points, no script
items.text: The browser handles the drag, the momentum and the keyboard.

items.title: The row is a focus stop
items.text: So the arrow keys reach it without a pointer.

items.title: Compact narrows the cards
items.text: More of them are visible at once, at the cost of copy length.

items.title: The next card peeks
items.text: A card cut off at the edge is the only honest promise that there is more.
